segments.text: What doth God require of us that we may escape his wrath and curse due to us for sin
To escape the wrath and curse of God, due to us for sin, God requireth of us faith in Jesus Christ, repentance unto life,
with the diligent use of all the outward means whereby Christ communicateth to us the benefits of redemption.
Larger Catechism one hundred and fifty-three
What doth God require of us, that we may escape his wrath and curse due to us by reason of the transgression of the law
That we may escape the wrath and curse of God due to us by reason of the transgression of the law, he requireth of us repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ,
and the diligent use of the outward means whereby Christ communicates to us the benefits of his mediation.
